configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Common settings, never configured directly. Each preset gets its own build tree under build/, so switching presets never re-configures on top of another generator's cache.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: The everyday local preset on macOS and Linux; on Windows it needs an x64 Native Tools prompt, because Ninja does not find cl.exe by itself. Debug and Release share one configure: build dev-debug or dev-release.

configurePresets.name: vs
configurePresets.description: Windows only, from any shell. No generator string on purpose: CMake picks the newest Visual Studio it finds, so this does not rot at the next VS release.

configurePresets.name: strict
configurePresets.displayName: strict (warnings as errors, our code only)
configurePresets.description: LIKYU_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON. Reaches likyu::warnings, which vendor sources never link. On Windows from a plain shell, configure vs with -DLIKYU_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON instead.

configurePresets.name: ci-linux
configurePresets.description: What the Linux CI job configures: dev plus ccache.

configurePresets.name: ci-macos
configurePresets.description: What the macOS CI job configures: dev plus ccache, native architecture only. The universal build belongs to the installers (devplan Phase 7).

configurePresets.name: ci-windows
configurePresets.description: What the Windows CI job configures. No compiler cache: sccache with MSVC needs /Z7, and juce_recommended_config_flags gives /Zi in Debug (go.dot found this first).

configurePresets.name: reference
configurePresets.displayName: reference (lib/dsp without intrinsics, fused arithmetic, no plugins)
configurePresets.description: LIKYU_SIMD=reference and no plugins: lib/dsp's kernels over plain arrays, in the same fused arithmetic as the SIMD builds, with its suite and the bench. What CI holds the SIMD builds to: the same bits (devplan Phase 7; scripts/same-bits.sh). On Windows from a plain shell, configure vs with -DLIKYU_SIMD=reference -DLIKYU_BUILD_PLUGINS=OFF -B build/reference instead.

configurePresets.name: scalar
configurePresets.displayName: scalar (lib/dsp without intrinsics or FMA, no plugins)
configurePresets.description: LIKYU_SIMD=scalar and no plugins: what an x86 processor older than AVX2 gets. No fused multiply-add there, so its own arithmetic, held by its own suite and not to the others' bits. On arm64 it is the reference. On Windows from a plain shell, configure vs with -DLIKYU_SIMD=scalar -DLIKYU_BUILD_PLUGINS=OFF -B build/scalar instead.

configurePresets.name: rtsan
configurePresets.description: LIKYU_RTSAN=ON and no plugins: lib/dsp and its suite alone, under -fsanitize=realtime. Needs CC and CXX to name a Clang 20 or later; the CI job sets them.

testPresets.name: release-dsp
testPresets.description: lib/dsp's suite and the bench's smoke runs in Release (devplan Phase 7): the optimised build is the one that ships, and Debug never shows what an optimiser or a SIMD kernel does. Build likyu_dsp_tests and likyu_bench in Release first. The suites that need JUCE stay in Debug.
